attributes.name: Saluki
attributes.description: The Saluki is a graceful and elegant breed, originating in the Middle East. They are a sight hound, and have a long, sleek coat in a variety of colors. They are highly intelligent, and have an independent nature. They are a fast breed, and have a long stride, and can be used for racing and coursing. They are loyal and devoted to their family, and make good companions.
